test_title: PYST 12: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 07 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends, R, S, T, X, Y and Z, are sitting in a straight row facing north (but not necessarily in the same order) . Only two people sit to the left of Y. Only two people sit between Y and Z. Only one person sits between Z and X. R sits to the immediate left of S. How many people sit between Y and S?
solution:
Given, Six friends, R, S, T, X, Y and Z, are sitting in a straight row facing north (but not necessarily in the same order) .

Only two people sit to the left of Y.

Only two people sit between Y and Z.

Only one person sits between Z and X.
